[SWS_SM_00711] Trigger to enter and leave Suspend Mode
Status:
DRAFT
Upstream requirements:
RS_SM_00402
⌈
On receiving a suspend trigger, the
S2R Satellite
shall invoke
ara::sm::s2r::
S2RSatellite::EnterSuspendMode
.
On receiving a resume trigger, it shall invoke
ara::sm::s2r::S2RSatellite::
LeaveSuspendMode
.
⌋
